YuneMusic

Official repository of YuneMusic, an ad-free music player for YouTube content. Source code: https://github.com/quompacc/yunemusic

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quompacc/yunemusic/fdroid/repo
